chunks: The Pharaoh had led his people astray, and did not rightly guide them.

key_terms.أَضَلَ: He led astray or caused to go wrong
key_terms.فِرْعَوُنُ: Pharaoh, the ruler of Egypt in the Quranic narrative

ai.seo_question: How did Pharaoh lead his people astray according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *dalal* (misguidance) as a consequence of Pharaoh's arrogant claim to divinity, which severed his connection to true *huda* (guidance). It illustrates the theological principle that political power without spiritual insight leads to collective deviation, a theme frequently cited by Imams to contrast earthly tyrants with the divinely guided leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt.
